gpuDvfsLimitation.observation: During a 91 s run of the fixed scene, NVML 576.80 sampled at 50 ms recorded 180 SM clock transitions between 63 and 1519 MHz (P3/P5/P8) at 6.9-9.0% utilization; the scene costs about 0.1 ms GPU work per 16.67 ms frame.
gpuDvfsLimitation.clockLockAttempt: nvidia-smi -lgc 300, -lgc 600 and -lgc 1800 all exited 0, but SM clocks stayed at 36-224 MHz and persistence mode reports [N/A]. GeForce/WDDM does not enforce application clock locks on this machine.
gpuDvfsLimitation.consequence: GPU p95 is recorded as reference data only; T1 reproducibility gates CPU p95, screenshots, graphics-driver memory and pass order.
